# Mold Roster

> Mold Roster is a free directory of state-licensed mold assessors and remediators in Texas, Florida, New York and Washington DC, built from official licence records.

Mold Roster is for homeowners, tenants, landlords, buyers and insurance claimants who need a licensed mold assessor (inspection/testing) or remediator (removal). Listings come from TDLR (TX), DBPR (FL), NYS DOL (NY) and DOEE (DC) records retrieved 2026-10-12. A listing is not an endorsement. Every page has a Markdown version: replace the trailing slash with `.md` (home: https://moldroster.com/index.md).

## States
- [Texas](https://moldroster.com/tx/): Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation licence records
- [Florida](https://moldroster.com/fl/): Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation licence records
- [New York](https://moldroster.com/ny/): New York State Department of Labor licence records
- [Washington, DC](https://moldroster.com/dc/): DC Department of Energy & Environment licence records

## Get free quotes

- https://moldroster.com/quotes/: send one request to up to 3 licensed mold pros near a Texas, New York or Washington, DC ZIP. From a pro's profile, "Get a quote" sends it to that pro plus the 2 nearest other licensed pros that offer the service. Free, no obligation. Florida isn't covered (DBPR records have no phone or email).
- Every listing has a profile page under /tx/firms/, /fl/firms/, /ny/firms/ and /dc/firms/ (A–Z indexes at those URLs).
- Guides hub: https://moldroster.com/guides/
